attributes.provenance: Image-wide census 2026-09-01, worktree GDL-Claude-LiveZero, over all 257 paired units, joining the extracted target objects (build/GUNE5D/obj) with our RAW compiler output (build/GUNE5D/src/**/.postprocess/body, falling back to the plain object) so WebFrank-postprocessed bytes cannot flatter the count. Every differing word of every equal-size paired function was decoded into the copy family {mr, addi-copy, ori-copy, li, lis}; 598 family sites over 118 functions. Each of the four unconditional hits and each of the seven payoff candidates was then confirmed or refuted by an aligned fnasm --diff read, never by the positional pairing alone.

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: TAXONOMY OF THE LIVE-ZERO / CONSTANT-COPY FORM FAMILY, AND THE PAYOFF INVERSION THAT SHOULD DRIVE ALL FUTURE WORK ON IT. The lane premise was that the cheap sub-case (unconditional `mr` vs `addi rD,rS,0`, rS!=0) should be built first and the li-vs-copy variant deferred because it needs a dataflow proof. THE MEASURED POPULATIONS ARE THE EXACT OPPOSITE, and building only the cheap case would have shipped a rule with an EMPTY payoff set. FORM-PAIR CENSUS over 257 units: same-form pairs dominate and are NOT this family at all — 431 addi_copy/addi_copy and 106 mr/mr sites differ only in register fields and are ordinary recolor work for copy_register_fields; counting them into the family is how the '22 recorded functions' figure overstates it. Genuine FORM-differing pairs, 100 functions: li->addi_copy 12, addi_copy->li 5, lis->addi_copy 5, li->mr 5, addi_copy->mr 5, addi_copy->lis 3, mr->addi_copy 3, mr->li 1, li->lis 1, lis->li 1. FINDING 1 — THE UNCONDITIONAL CLASS HAS NO PAYOFF. Image-wide there are exactly FOUR sites where both sides decode as the same copy rD<-rS with rS!=0: CritterLineRootColSub@0x40 (critter), PlayVQMovie@0x144 (movieplayer), pbSendObjTextures@0x14 (pb_objects), do_player_select@0x7e8 (select). Not one of them is a function whose only residual is that word — they sit at real 42, 72, 16 and 1094 respectively, every one of them alongside unpaired schedule words, so none is closable by any single-stage rule. CORRECTION, per claim.law.RQ_webfrank-audit-silence-is-not-ineligibility.20260901.v1 which landed while this census was running: webfrank_audit's silence on pb_objects ('0 register-only; 0 eligible; 0 rejected') means only that the audit scans the pure-recolor subclass and a displaced function appears in NEITHER list — it is NOT a verdict of WebFrank-ineligibility, and the WebFrank-closable set is strictly larger than what the audit reports. Read the silence as 'no opinion', screen candidates manually, and note that a COMPOSED permute+form+recolor rule may still reach these four; what is established here is only that no single-stage rule does. Two of the four (CritterLineRootColSub, do_player_select) sit inside heavily displaced regions and are positional-pairing ARTIFACTS that the aligned read dissolves. A rule restricted to the unconditional class would close zero functions, and applying it anyway would hash-freeze functions that still have live source residuals — a real cost for no matched%. FINDING 2 — ALL THE VALUE IS IN THE li VARIANT. Filtering instead for functions whose ENTIRE residual is copy-family words (nothing structural, scheduled or immediate left over) yields SEVEN candidates, and every one of them is li-vs-copy with unconditional=0: AudioBankQueueName(75), MtapOpenPort(83), AudioUnloadPart(95), CritterLoadDone(104), CritterLoadStartNext(108), AudioBankLoadName(115), fn_8006E654(369). Each is ONE word from byte-exact. Four were driven EXACT this session by the dominating_def proof (the three audio.c bank-name loops and fn_8006E654; matched 62.37% -> 62.62%). MtapOpenPort is REFUSED by the guard and stays source work: its site +0xac is the target of the `bne` at +0x98, so no local scan can establish r28==1 on both incoming edges. CritterLoadDone and CritterLoadStartNext are NOT form work at all — a third finding worth its own line: our `addi r4,r3,0`/`li r5,K` pair appears at the target's `li r5,K`/`addi r4,r3,0` offsets, i.e. two ADJACENT INSTRUCTIONS SWAPPED, which is the existing permute_instruction_atoms stage's job and which naive positional decoding reports as two form differences. Anyone censusing this family by position must expect that false signature. PROCEDURE for the next lane: filter by 'other == 0' (residual entirely copy-family) FIRST, because that is what predicts a flip; the form pair only tells you which proof mode to name. Bidirectionality is confirmed in both classes (both mr->addi and addi->mr, both li->copy and copy->li occur), which independently corroborates claim.law.live-zero-copy-vs-remat-is-allocator-not-source.20260831.v1: neither encoding is a source property in either direction. CROSS-LANE VALIDATION, run after the rules landed, against sites scouted independently by lanes CT and RQ with no coordination on the guard's design: G3DReadControlPadStates +0x1c ACCEPTS under dominating_def and reaches the target word, while +0x38 and +0x3c both REFUSE with 'control instruction inside the proof span' at +0x24 — which is exactly the behaviour CT recommended on separate evidence (refuse bl-crossing windows rather than bake a callee-saved ABI assumption into a fail-closed guard). Two lanes converging on the same boundary from opposite directions is the strongest evidence available that the boundary is the right one. THE v2 REQUIREMENT, measured not speculated: RQ's camera_mode_level +0x8b0 is a genuine li-vs-copy site with its dominating-def obligation discharged (target `mr r29,r30`, ours `li r27,0`), and the shipped rule REFUSES it — because the destination registers differ, r27 against r29, so the site is a form change AND a recolor at once. The v1 stage runs before the recolor snapshot and therefore sees the pre-recolor destination; copy_register_fields, running after, would in turn choke on the form word. Neither stage can take this site alone and their current ORDER cannot be fixed by reordering: what v2 needs is a combined pass that applies the renaming and the form rewrite together and then discharges both obligations against the result. Same conclusion for the three remaining single-site functions (G3D +0x1c buys 1 of 20 rows, pbSendObjTextures 1 of 16): a rule that does not close a function should NOT be shipped merely because it is provable, because a WebFrank rule hash-freezes the compiled body and would park live source work for no matched% — this session applied rules ONLY where the function reached byte-exact, and left the rest measured and open.
